title: model-catalog: expose capability flags and pricing/limits fields; stabilize streaming/OpenAI compat
author: Maya Chen
description: Add explicit capability flags and pricing/limits fields to the model catalog API and stabilize streaming behavior in the OpenAI compatibility layer. Motivation: customers and SDKs need a consistent, discoverable capability surface so clients can adjust behavior (enable streaming, function/tool calling, structured output) and enforce safety/cost guards. This PR introduces new fields on the model listing and single-model endpoints: supports_streaming, supports_functions, supports_structured_output, openai_compatible, price_per_1k_tokens, price_per_token, max_tokens, context_window, and tier_limits. It also extends query params to allow filtering by capability (e.g., ?capability=streaming&capability=functions) and adds a compatibility flag mapping in the OpenAI adapter so legacy clients behave consistently. To address streaming stability we made framing improvements (SSE chunk delimiters, backpressure-aware buffer limits), added retry-on-chunk-failure hooks, and added end-of-stream sentinel tokens for structured outputs so SDKs can reliably parse partial JSON. Changes are backward compatible: fields are optional and default to conservative values. Includes migration script to populate common models in the registry with capability and pricing metadata, API docs and SDK mappings, unit/integration tests, and a README for operators describing new config knobs. Checklist: - [x] API schema and OpenAPI docs updated - [x] Migration script included - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Backwards compatibility verification - [x] SDK adapter updates - [x] Observability events for capability-driven routing

review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Overall looks good; can we name price_per_token vs price_per_1k_tokens consistently across SDKs? Also request to add an explicit default for missing fields (suggest null vs 0).

Maya Chen (author): Agree on naming consistency. Kept both fields; price_per_token is primary, price_per_1k_tokens is computed for convenience. Default is null to indicate unknown; updated docs to call out behavior.
Priya Patel: Question about filtering semantics: should multiple capability params be treated as AND or OR? Recommend OR (any capability matches) for discoverability.
Maya Chen (author): Implemented OR semantics and added unit tests (test_model_catalog_filters.py).
Diego Alvarez: Streaming changes look safer but add a guard for very large partial messages to avoid OOM on client side. Consider capping parser buffer and dropping/parsing error telemetry.
Maya Chen (author): Added buffer cap and error telemetry hook in openai_compat/adapter; updated tests to simulate oversized chunks.

release_notes: Expose model capabilities (streaming, functions, structured output) and pricing/limits in model catalog API. Add filters for capability-based discovery. Stabilize streaming framing in OpenAI compatibility layer and add client parsing improvements. Backfill script for common models included. Backwards compatible: new fields are optional and default to null/unknown.
additional_notes: Operator guidance: when deploying to Dedicated/Private, consider enabling capability backfill migration during low-traffic window; migration is idempotent.
SDK note: clients should check supports_structured_output before attempting JSON streaming parses; fallback to buffered parse if not supported.
Observability: new event 'capability_routing_augmented' emitted when requests are routed based on capabilities.
